senses.gloss:
m. (-रः)
1 A car, a carriage.
2 A tree.
n. (-रं)
Any vehicle.
E.
चकि a sautra root, to wonder, and उरच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Who or what goes slowly or crookedly.
n. (-णं)
Going, proceeding, going tortuously or slowly.
E.
क्रम to go, युच् affix, and the root reiterated.

f. (-मा)
Going tortuously or slowly.
E.
क्रम to go, root repeated, अङ् and टाप् aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Who or what moves slowly or crookedly.
E.
चङ्क्रमा, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
1 Handsome, beautiful.
2 Dexterous, clever.
3 Sound, healthy.
E.
चं the moon, and ग what goes; what resembles the moon in beauty, &c.

m. (-ङ्गः)
Whiteness or beauty of the teeth.
E.
चङ्ग handsome, affix अण्.

f. (-री)
Wood sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha, Rox.)
E.
चाङ्ग as above, and इर to send or cause, affixes अच् and ङीप्.
